title: The Paired Fog Discipline
summary: The school course in laying two banks of fog in a pair and finishing with the school's twin oblivion that closes both on a foe.

title: Manual of the Azure Fog Court
summary: The school manual of a court of azure fog that tries each foe in turn and ends with the school's convened court of mist.

title: The Hawk Above the Brume
summary: The school's high course of the hawk that rides above the brume and drops through it unseen onto a single foe.

title: The Oath Fog Discipline
summary: The school discipline of swearing a fog to keep faith and ending with the school's oathbound fog that holds the faithless fast.

title: Reckoning of the Wind-Fed Haze
summary: The school reckoning of a haze fed by the plateau wind that grows without bound and ends in the school's unfenced haze.

title: The Mist With No Walls
summary: The school's high course of a mist that has no wall and no edge and fills whatever ground it is given.
